entries.description: hollywood is a free, open-source (Apache-2.0) program that splits a terminal into tmux panes and fills each one with busy-looking output: a world map as ASCII art, falling characters, hex dumps, scrolling source code, SSH key art, network throughput and more - twenty widgets, dealt again every few seconds. This is the macOS port of Dustin Kirkland's hollywood: it replaces the Linux-only paths and ships small stand-ins for the programs Homebrew does not have, so it runs on a Mac with one command and behaves on Linux as before. It makes no network requests and needs no configuration.
